interpretation: Audit of implementation and stored artifacts passed; the candidate failed all four preregistered acceptance gates. Audit PASS is not strategy acceptance.
scope: Read-only independent audit of frozen C runner and all prepared/evaluated artifacts; no new configuration, detection run, scoring run, source edit, monitor change or deployment.
audit_procedures: Verified SHA256 of all prepared source inputs, ten source pins against commit c4fc164, all 285 prepared artifacts and all final validation artifacts.

Independently derived causal rolling features and ran a separately written audit state loop; did not import or call detect/early_fields/path_reference. Compared 17,582,019 saved state values across 837,239 bars.
Reconstructed signal matching, true parent identities, reference/suppression coverage, exposure and deterministic controls from features and saved state without changing selection.

Compared old cache keys across all duplicates, then independently traversed each of 39,086 unique recorded execution paths using raw OHLC/ATR and frozen risk arithmetic; no simulate_trade call or new trading configuration.
Independently recomputed every published period summary, own-event matched controls, asset/week sign permutations, descriptive rank AUC/top-decile and three-hypothesis Holm correction.
Verified all output hashes again after audits. Only this independent_review.json file is written by the reviewer.
limitations: All evaluated history was already seen. This is sequential exploratory research, not blind out-of-sample evidence.
The fixed 278-market study is historical OKX 1H only, excluding BTC/ETH; it does not establish other venues, timeframes or current-universe performance.
All real stored segments are continuous; gap behavior was audited in source and synthetic tests, not represented by actual gapped market segments.

Historical raw OHLC and upstream frozen feature correctness were authenticated and their needed derived windows independently recomputed; this audit did not refetch exchange history or rederive every upstream MA/ATR feature.
Reference occupancy is measured at signal-close prices; economics use actual next-open fills. Neither reference_active nor suppression_active is an account position.
reference_qualified can remain true after exit; coverage was explicitly verified against live suppression_active, not this persistent flag.
Independent economic events may overlap; no portfolio allocation, NAV or portfolio maximum drawdown was computed.
Fixed20bp cost omits funding, impact and venue-specific execution frictions.
Three-hypothesis Holm includes frozen A/B/C only; earlier13 exploratory gates remain disclosed and this is not a global correction for the entire research history.
No new native Pine C parity or live deployment verification was performed.

Reviewer is a separate implementation reviewer of C, but previously authored B and the A/B report builder in the same research program; independence refers to separate audit calculations, not a blinded independent research organization.
